audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange rate formula uses the accounting field `self.cash` (not `underlying_balance.value()`), so direct donations to `underlying_balance` have zero effect on the rate. Sui's capability model additionally prevents any external module from writing to `underlying_balance` without going through `reserve.move`'s internal functions. All protocol operations maintain exchange rate monotonicity: mint/burn use floor-rounding in favour of the pool, borrow/repay produce zero net numerator change, and interest accrual strictly increases the numerator.
